hypothesis: W-R38 proved exact XOR55 invariance but lost all heldout temporal utility with a single scalar repeated 16 times. Expose 16 distinct pre-specified XOR-invariant statistics of the same adjacent transition mismatches, preserving the same 16-weight-plus-bias readout and identical learning budget. Test whether ordered statistics or popcount histograms recover discriminative temporal information without XOR-coded training.
freeze: Freeze three representation arms, training seeds1824..1839, sealed heldout1840..1855, four-bit clean sensor data, XOR55 recoding only AFTER quantization, same generators, 32 perceptron epochs and all metrics before first use. Do not use W-R38 heldout for new training or select a variant after first-use.
arms: scalar_repeated: exact W-R38 16-copy top-two popcount residual scalar
top16_sorted: descending largest sixteen of 64 per-edge/channel popcount residuals
histogram: first nine components count popcount residuals equal to values0..8, remaining seven components fixed zero (width16)
training: Each arm receives SAME 1728 identity-only clean 4-bit observed reference/candidate balanced pairs, dev affine_prior family, 16 seed x9 entity x3 train swap x2 amplitudes x2 labels, 32 epochs, LR0.1, 16 trained weights+bias, no early stopping or label filtering.
evaluation: Identity and XOR55 encoding, 3 fixed generator families, 2 heldout swap positions, unseen sealed seeds1840..1855; include indistinguishable positive/negative pairs and per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN. Each feature MUST be exactly invariant to XOR55 transformation applied to both base/candidate; preserve any violations as invalid, not scientific negative.
primary: XOR_ROBUST_UTILITY iff a new 16-feature arm has >=0.65 heldout accuracy under both identity and XOR55 and exceeds scalar_repeated by >=0.10 on paired heldout; PARTIAL_GAIN iff at least one new arm beats baseline by >=0.05 without meeting strict threshold; NO_GAIN otherwise. Report all three representations and both encodings, even null/negative.
controls: No privileged decoder/XOR key supplied to model, no extra model calls, class labels in features, future states or sample screening
Same 16 numerical weights for each arm, but 16 distinct inputs have greater effective expressivity than duplicated scalar; disclose this, do not claim identical effective hypothesis class
Frozen original W-R38 source as exact immutable foundation and bounded new feature/statistics only
One first-use original artifact followed by one full Go repository test and build; no acceptance/promotion/production authority
claim_limit: Synthetic XOR55-invariant fixed-width transition statistic learning, not general byte-permutation invariance or natural-language reasoning.
